overview_description.description: Frizzle provides an AI-powered grading tool for math assignments. The platform can grade both handwritten and typed student solutions. It offers instant step-by-step feedback to help students understand their mistakes. The system tracks class performance and identifies students who may need help. It is designed for teachers to save time on grading and focus on teaching.
